import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.CartierKernelChartDivisor
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyChartSections
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModulesLocal

/-!
# The Weil divisor ideal of a divisor family

The Cartier equations of an actual divisor family identify its kernel with
the ideal of rational functions bounded by the negative effective Weil divisor.
The comparison retains the inclusion into the structure sheaf, as required
by Kleiman, *The Picard scheme*, Section 3, `sb:ediv`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverModule overModule divisorSectionsModule

variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

/-- A principal equation on an open identifies the negative-divisor bound
with divisibility in the ring of regular functions on that open. -/
theorem germ_mem_divisorSections_neg_iff_dvd
    (D : X.CurveDivisor) (g : X.functionFieldˣ) (W : X.Opens)
    (hW : (W : Set X).Nonempty) (a : Γ(X, W))
    (ha : (X.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X)
      (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hW)).hom a = (g : X.functionField))
    (hD : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ W →
      coeffAt hz (divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) g) = coeffAt hz D)
    (r : Γ(X, W)) :
    (X.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X) (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hW)).hom r ∈
      divisorSections K (-D) W ↔ a ∣ r := by
  let γ := (X.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X)
    (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hW)).hom
  have heq : divisorSections K (-D) W =
      divisorSections K (0 - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) g) W := by
    apply divisorSections_eq_of_coeffAt_eq_on
    intro z hz hzW
    simp only [zero_sub, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_neg, hD z hz hzW]
  rw [heq]
  constructor
  · intro hr
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (divisorMulPresheafApp_bijective K g 0 W).surjective ⟨γ r, hr⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (moduleToDivisorZeroPresheafApp_bijective K W).surjective t
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    apply germ_injective_of_isIntegral X (U := W) (genericPoint X)
      (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hW)
    have hv := congrArg (fun s : divisorSections K
      (0 - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) g) W => (s : X.functionField)) ht
    rw [divisorMulPresheafApp_coe_of_nonempty K g 0 hW, ← hb,
      moduleToDivisorZeroPresheafApp_coe_of_nonempty K hW] at hv
    exact hv.symm.trans (by rw [map_mul, ha])
  · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
    have hm := (divisorMulPresheafApp K g 0 W
      (moduleToDivisorZeroPresheafApp K W b)).property
    rw [divisorMulPresheafApp_coe_of_nonempty K g 0 hW,
      moduleToDivisorZeroPresheafApp_coe_of_nonempty K hW] at hm
    simpa only [map_mul, ha] using hm

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily

variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π] [GeometricallyIntegral π] [IsProper π]
variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {s : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ S}

local instance : IsIntegral (pullback π s) := fieldTest_isIntegral (π := π) (s := s)
noncomputable local instance : (pullback π s).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  .ofHom (pullback.snd π s)
local instance : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
    ((pullback π s) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  fieldTest_smooth (π := π) (s := s)
local instance : LocallyOfFiniteType
    ((pullback π s) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.snd π s))
local instance : QuasiCompact ((pullback π s) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact (pullback.snd π s))

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- On every nonempty subopen of a Cartier chart, the actual divisor quotient
kills precisely the regular functions bounded by its negative Weil divisor. -/
theorem chartQuotient_eq_zero_iff_germ_mem
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) (U : (pullback π s).Opens) [Nonempty U]
    (e : kernel (chartQuotient x U) ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)
    (V : (U : Scheme).Opens)
    (hV : ((U.ι ''ᵁ V : (pullback π s).Opens) : Set (pullback π s : Scheme)).Nonempty)
    (r : Γ((U : Scheme), V)) :
    (chartQuotient x U).val.app (op V) r = 0 ↔
      ((pullback π s).presheaf.germ (U.ι ''ᵁ V) (genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme))
        (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hV)).hom r ∈
        divisorSections K (-x.effectiveWeilDivisor) (U.ι ''ᵁ V) := by
  let a := (U : Scheme).presheaf.map (homOfLE (show V ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
    (chartLocalEquation x U e)
  have ha : ((pullback π s).presheaf.germ (U.ι ''ᵁ V)
      (genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme)) (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hV)).hom a =
      (chartEquationUnit x U e : (pullback π s : Scheme).functionField) := by
    change ((pullback π s).presheaf.germ (U.ι ''ᵁ V) _ _).hom
      ((pullback π s).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (U.ι.image_mono (show V ≤ ⊤ from le_top))).op
        (chartLocalEquation x U e)) = _
    rw [(pullback π s).presheaf.germ_res_apply]
    rfl
  have h := germ_mem_divisorSections_neg_iff_dvd K x.effectiveWeilDivisor
    (chartEquationUnit x U e) (U.ι ''ᵁ V) hV a ha
    (fun z hz hzV => coeffAt_divOf_chartEquationUnit x U e z hz (U.ι_image_le V hzV)) r
  exact (CartierKernel.quotient_eq_zero_iff_dvd_localEquation
    (chartQuotient x U) (Iso.refl _) e V r).trans h.symm

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- On a Cartier chart, the ambient quotient kills precisely the regular
functions bounded by the negative effective Weil divisor. -/
theorem normalizedQuotient_eq_zero_iff_germ_mem
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) (U : (pullback π s).Opens) [Nonempty U]
    (e : kernel (chartQuotient x U) ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)
    (V : (U : Scheme).Opens)
    (hV : ((U.ι ''ᵁ V : (pullback π s).Opens) : Set (pullback π s : Scheme)).Nonempty)
    (r : Γ((U : Scheme), V)) :
    (normalizedQuotient x).val.app (op (U.ι ''ᵁ V)) r = 0 ↔
      ((pullback π s).presheaf.germ (U.ι ''ᵁ V) (genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme))
        (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hV)).hom r ∈
        divisorSections K (-x.effectiveWeilDivisor) (U.ι ''ᵁ V) :=
  (chartQuotient_eq_zero_iff_normalizedQuotient x U V r).symm.trans
    (chartQuotient_eq_zero_iff_germ_mem x U e V hV r)

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily
